mintAuthority.summary: MetaMask USD is an M0-backed extension; extension wrapping routes through M0 SwapFacility infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway. The MUSD token and SwapFacility are transparent proxies, with the material Ethereum, Linea, and Monad deployments governed through independently verified ProxyAdmin owners.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing MUSD depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: MUSD token upgrade timelock

routeChecks.signingModel: On Ethereum, Linea, and Monad, the same-address 3-of-5 Safe 0x5916ec446793e8740645e57a63dc7bc5910c7724 holds proposer, executor, and canceller roles on this same-address timelock.
routeChecks.rateLimits: getMinDelay() returned 259,200 seconds on each material deployment.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Each MUSD token proxy has ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9, whose owner() returned this timelock on Ethereum, Linea, and Monad.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531380, Linea block 31369840, and Monad block 87714833, the tracked MUSD token's canonical EIP-1967 admin slot 0xb5312768...d6103 returned ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9 on all three chains; each OpenZeppelin v5 proxy runtime independently embedded the same immutable admin address. ProxyAdmin owner() returned this timelock on all three chains; getMinDelay() returned 259,200 seconds, and live role reads confirmed the same 3-of-5 Safe as proposer, executor, and canceller on each deployment.

review.evidence: The MinterGateway remains an immutable non-proxy on Ethereum. At Ethereum block 25531380, Linea block 31369840, and Monad block 87714833, the tracked MUSD token and SwapFacility remained TransparentUpgradeableProxy deployments. On all six proxy reads, the canonical EIP-1967 admin slot returned the recorded token or SwapFacility ProxyAdmin and the runtime independently embedded that same OpenZeppelin v5 immutable admin. The MUSD token's common ProxyAdmin is owned by the same 259,200-second TimelockController on all three chains, with the same 3-of-5 Safe holding proposer, executor, and canceller roles. SwapFacility uses a separate common ProxyAdmin: its owner is a three-day timelock on Ethereum and Linea, but a direct 3-of-5 Safe on Monad. The MetaMask USD audit explicitly identifies the proxy-admin owner as able to replace token logic.
